How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 2) aligns with the 12.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, warm tungsten golden light with light film grain, a company dinner four years ago; gentle handheld breathing camera. The shot opens exactly on the same crisp shrimp-shell crack carried over from the previous scene — a hard sound-bridge cut from the present into four years ago. Matching Picture 1, Chen Yu — short black hair, blue crew-neck top, steady, head down — cracks and peels a whole poached shrimp, a small pile of shells already before him, while beside him Lin Wan's small bowl holds a few peeled shrimp. Chen Yu keeps peeling continuously; the pile of shells visibly grows taller and more peeled shrimp accumulate in Lin Wan's bowl. The camera breathes and eases from the close view of his hands out to a two-person relationship framing (one continuous take, no hard cut). Lin Wan — same face, four years younger, warmer, secure in being adored — lifts a freshly peeled shrimp up to her eyes as if inspecting how clean it is, suppressing a smile, and says: <d>[Chinese]你能不能快点？我这边都断供了。</d> Chen Yu, without looking up, keeps peeling and answers in a steady low voice: <d>[Chinese]着什么急。</d> The ending matches Picture 2: a distinctly taller pile of shells, Lin Wan's bowl noticeably fuller with peeled shrimp, and Lin Wan holding up the peeled shrimp with a suppressed smile.

overall_soundscape: Warm, full dinner-party ambience with overlapping laughter and chatter; the incoming crisp shrimp-shell crack lands right at the very start as the sound bridge, then the steady small sounds of shells being cracked, peeled and dropped onto the growing pile.

non_diegetic_music: Warm sustained strings at a slow tempo with a soft rounded low end, tender and unhurried.
